scenario_definitions.symmetric_footprints: Repeated across-grid pinhole footprints; signed cross-track arctan offset/H, arbitrary 90/270 degree absolute directions. Spacing/origin synthetic.
scenario_definitions.alternating_strips: Constant 15 degree zenith and alternating 0/180 absolute azimuth at half-footprint strip width. Tracks/directions synthetic.
scenario_definitions.mosaic_edges: 0 to25 degree zenith from normalized distance to mosaic center; radial assumed azimuth.
scenario_definitions.smooth_map: 5 to25 degree zenith across columns; hypothetical smooth absolute azimuth from row and column coordinates.
scenario_definitions.smooth_map_reflected: Same illustrative formula with cross-grid coordinate reflected; equally unsupported alternative.

azimuth_convention: Clockwise absolute sensor azimuth; relative = circular(sensor minus solar). Constant cases convert absolute=(solar+relative) modulo360. Grid patterns do not reconstruct true-North camera directions; no actual track/north-convergence inference is made.
